name: FT232H PM2.5 UART 3686 Demo
description: Tests the Adafruit PM2.5 Air Quality Sensor + breadboard adapter kit (PID 3686, PMS5003) read over UART by an FTDI FT232H breakout, wired through a Jumperless V5 crossbar. Responds to checkin, then adds the pm25 UART driver. FT232H hardware UART is fixed: TX=AD0 (D0), RX=AD1 (D1); the serial port opens as the pyftdi URL 'ftdi://ftdi:232h/1'. Sensor wiring (rows 53-58 = vcc,gnd,set,rxd,txd,rst): VCC->FT232H 5V, GND->FT232H GND, SET->3V (active), RXD->FT232H D0 (TX), TXD->FT232H D1 (RX), RST->3V (out of reset).

steps.description: Respond to device checkin with OK and board capabilities
